tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: What this server offers across energy, sensors, weather and news: endpoints, prices and the first calls to make. No key needed.

tools.name: create_free_api_key
tools.description: Create a FREE AgentDataAPI key (no signup) valid for every slice. Returned once; add it to the server's X-API-Key header.

tools.name: grid_regions
tools.description: Every power market region we serve: code, market, timezone, currency, source and price cadence.

tools.name: grid_price
tools.description: Latest settled wholesale electricity price for a region (micro units of local currency, USD conversion, demand, negative-price flag).

tools.name: grid_day_ahead
tools.description: Day-ahead (EU) or pre-dispatch (NEM) prices per interval for a local day, with min, max, average and negative intervals.

tools.name: grid_price_history
tools.description: Settled prices for the last 7 days (Pro), optionally averaged per 30 or 60 minutes.

tools.name: grid_load
tools.description: Latest grid demand for a region in MW.

tools.name: grid_generation
tools.description: Latest generation mix for a region: MW per fuel, total and renewables share (basis points).

tools.name: grid_cheapest_window
tools.description: Cheapest contiguous window of N hours in the next horizon from day-ahead or pre-dispatch prices (GB: greenest window from the carbon forecast).

tools.name: grid_carbon
tools.description: GB grid carbon intensity in gCO2/kWh: actual and forecast now, the next 6 hours, and the regional generation mix.

tools.name: petroleum_weekly
tools.description: Latest EIA weekly US petroleum inventory figure with the previous week and the change.

tools.name: sensors_stations_near
tools.description: Stations of every open sensor network near a point, nearest first, with distance and parameters.

tools.name: sensors_air
tools.description: Latest air quality readings and US EPA AQI at one monitor.

tools.name: sensors_air_near
tools.description: Air quality monitors near a point with latest readings (PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2, SO2, CO) and AQI, nearest first.

tools.name: sensors_water_gauge
tools.description: Latest river gauge height, discharge and water temperature at a USGS site, with NWS flood stage status.

tools.name: sensors_water_history
tools.description: Gauge readings for the last 7 days at a USGS site, newest first (Pro).

tools.name: sensors_tides
tools.description: Latest observed water level (metres MLLW) at a NOAA tide station with the next high and low.

tools.name: sensors_tide_predictions
tools.description: Predicted high and low tides for a day at a NOAA tide station.

tools.name: sensors_quakes
tools.description: Earthquakes in the last N hours from USGS, optionally above a magnitude and within a radius of a point.

tools.name: weather_alerts
tools.description: Active weather alerts for a region, severity first. US from the National Weather Service; Australia from the Bureau of Meteorology where licensed.

tools.name: weather_current
tools.description: Current conditions at the nearest reporting station (within 150 km) in the United States or Australia.

tools.name: weather_forecast
tools.description: Hourly GFS forecast (temperature, humidity, wind, gust, precipitation, cloud) for a point in the contiguous US or Australia.

tools.name: weather_forecast_daily
tools.description: Daily forecast summary (min and max temperature, wind, gust, precipitation total) for a point in the contiguous US or Australia.

tools.name: weather_stations_near
tools.description: Reporting stations near a point in the United States or Australia, nearest first.

tools.name: news_search_entities
tools.description: Search the tracked entities (organisations, tickers, crypto assets, central banks, governments, topics) and get their ids.

tools.name: news_sentiment
tools.description: News tone (bps), mentions against the 30-day baseline, volume ratio, novelty and top themes for one entity.

tools.name: news_ticker_score
tools.description: News score for a ticker: how unusual the coverage volume is and how its tone compares with normal.

tools.name: news_trending
tools.description: Entities with the most unusual news volume in the window, ranked by novelty against their baseline.

tools.name: news_sentiment_history
tools.description: Mentions and tone per window or per day for an entity (Pro), newest first.

tools.name: news_trending_people
tools.description: Public figures with the biggest attention spike (Wikipedia pageviews and news coverage over their 30-day baseline), by category.

tools.name: news_trending_topics
tools.description: Trending topics for a region: top daily searches with headlines, trending Mastodon tags and shared links.

tools.name: news_top_stories
tools.description: The most-covered stories in the window (title, link, publisher, tone), never article text.
